name: pixly
description: Host and manage Minecraft servers on Pixly.

interface.longDescription: Pixly is a Minecraft server host. This plugin manages the Minecraft servers in your Pixly account: create a server, start or stop it, change its settings, mods and plugins, read the console, and create or restore backups. Servers sleep when nobody is playing and wake when a player joins.
defaultPrompt: List my Pixly servers and tell me which ones are running.
Create a Paper survival server called Weekend SMP.
Back up my server, then show me its latest console output.

positive.description: Lists the account's servers and their state
positive.prompt: Which of my Pixly Minecraft servers are running right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls listServers and answers with each server's name and whether it is running, starting or asleep.

positive.description: Creates a new server without starting it
positive.prompt: Create a Paper survival server on Pixly called Weekend SMP.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls createServer with the name Weekend SMP and type PAPER, then explains that the server is asleep until it is started or a player joins.

positive.description: Starts an existing server by name
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the server with listServers, calls runServerAction with action start, and says the server will be online in a few minutes.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest console output from Weekend SMP.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the server, calls getConsoleLogs and summarises the recent output, quoting any errors.

positive.description: Backs up a world before a risky change
positive.prompt: Back up Weekend SMP before I change its mods.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the server, calls createBackup and confirms the backup was started.

negative.description: Wallet top-up is not available through the plugin
negative.prompt: Add 20 dollars to my Pixly balance.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool and tells the user that funds are managed on pixly.gg.

negative.description: Destructive request without a named server and confirmation
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call deleteServer. Lists the servers and asks the user to confirm which server to delete.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any Pixly tool.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Running servers use the balance of the user's existing Pixly account, which is managed on pixly.gg.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list, create, start and stop servers, change settings and mods, read the console, and manage backups.
